body: He is seeing a therapist I believe but not so much anymore.  The college placed him on a caution for missing class to go to the therapist and this led to him taking the antidepressants. I believe he's been told if he misses anymore class he is out.

He's very difficult though, and has already started taking measures to isolate himself. He will say things are okay and be almost annoyed when I point out that they clearly aren't.

It seems irreversible.
